$comment: Advisories bun audit may report without failing CI, each until its expiry (tooling/supply-chain/bun-audit.mjs, docs/migration/renovate.md). An entry past `expires` fails; an entry bun no longer reports fails too, so delete it in the change that clears it.

advisories.reason: Build-time only: tailwindcss 3 > micromatch > braces in the editor's CSS build, never shipped to a browser. No braces release fixes it (3.0.3 is the latest); Tailwind 4 drops the chain, and is held as its own series with a visual review (docs/migration/npm-latest.md).

Build-time only: tailwindcss 3 > postcss-nested > postcss-selector-parser 6 in the editor's CSS build. The fix is in 7.1.6, which postcss-nested under Tailwind 3 does not accept; Tailwind 4 clears it (held, docs/migration/npm-latest.md).
